annotations.title: Send product feedback to SignOff Studio

description: Sends a short report about SignOff Studio itself to its team: a bug, a confusing result or error, a missing capability, friction in a workflow, or an idea for a new feature. Returns the report id and, when the problem is already known, its workaround. Describe the problem in general terms: no URLs, hostnames, credentials, SQL, code, file paths or user data (reports containing them are refused). Sent anonymously with the product version and the names of recent tool calls.

summary.description: What happened or what is missing, in general terms

name: send_feedback

id.description: Report id, or the known issue's id

status.description: new: logged; known: already tracked (see workaround); duplicate: sent earlier from this machine; queued: offline, sent later; limited: daily limit reached
